index.title: S2 Documentation
index.subtitle: S2 (Scoped Storage) is a file storage service. Access your files via the Web UI, REST API, MCP, or WebDAV.

step1.text: Ask your S2 operator for an account, or sign up while registration is enabled from the

step2.title: 2. Upload Files
step2.text: After signing in, you can upload files from "My Files". The Web UI supports creating, editing, and deleting files.

rest.title: REST API
rest.desc: A simple HTTP API for uploading, downloading, and deleting files. Ideal for integrating S2 into your own apps or scripts.
rest.recommended: Recommended for: developers building custom integrations

webdav.title: WebDAV
webdav.desc: Open S2 as a regular folder in macOS Finder or Windows Explorer. No dedicated app required — works with built-in OS features.
webdav.recommended: Recommended for: non-engineers, anyone who prefers drag-and-drop file management

mcp.title: Remote MCP Server
mcp.desc: Connect ChatGPT or Claude to a folder in S2 with read or read-and-write permission.
mcp.recommended: Recommended for: connecting from the ChatGPT or Claude hosted UI (web / mobile)

webdav.title: WebDAV
webdav.subtitle: S2 supports the WebDAV protocol. Connect from macOS Finder, Windows Explorer, or any WebDAV client.

connection.title: Connection Details
connection.text: Files are scoped to your token's base path. The root directory (/dav/) shows only the files within your token's scope.

manage.title: Manage & disconnect
manage.body: Open Connections to see what's connected. Disconnect invalidates the token immediately.

checkBeforeAllow.q: Should I trust the consent screen?
checkBeforeAllow.a: S2 doesn't review connecting apps — check the app name and redirect URL on the consent screen and only continue if you started the connection.

connectionFailed.a: Check you're signed into S2 in the same browser and that third-party cookies aren't blocked.

outsideScope.a: It tried to access a path outside the folder you chose. Tell it to stay inside, or disconnect and reconnect with a wider folder.

tokenExpired.a: Refresh tokens last 30 days. You'll also see this if the connection was disconnected.
